name: Switzerland: Federal Council approach to AI regulation (ratification of Council of Europe AI Convention)
summary: On 12 February 2025 the Federal Council decided that Switzerland intends to ratify the Council of Europe Convention on AI and make the necessary amendments to Swiss law, while continuing sector-specific AI regulation. The Federal Chancellery page states a bill to be prepared by the FDJP with DETEC, the FDFA and other federal offices and submitted for consultation is due by end of 2026, along with a plan for non-binding measures, and that the Federal Chancellery has maintained an AI contact point for the Federal Administration since 1 February 2026. According to the Federal Chancellery, there is not yet any overarching legislation in Switzerland that deals specifically with AI.
key_obligations: Planned implementing bill to cover transparency, data protection, non-discrimination and supervision; consultation draft due by end of 2026 (bk.admin.ch)
Continued work on AI regulation in specific sectors such as healthcare and transport (Federal Council, 12 February 2025)
Non-binding measures (industry solutions, voluntary commitments) planned

timeline.note: Federal Council decides to ratify the Council of Europe AI Convention and amend Swiss law.
Federal Chancellery contact point on AI for the Federal Administration in operation; consultation bill (FDJP with DETEC and FDFA) and non-binding measures plan due by end of 2026.
